title: Mapping the TCR-Peptide-HLA Interface through Hydrogen-Deuterium Exchange Mass Spectrometry.
authors: Powell, Thomas; Colyer, Alice; Wildsmith, Gemma; Karuppiah, Vijaykumar; Shaikh, Saher Afshan; Ebner, Martin; Creese, Andrew; Calabrese, Antonio N
one_liner_zh: 该文用氢氘交换质谱结合结构预测研究TCR-pHLA结合界面，虽以实验为主，但涉及蛋白复合物结构计算整合，对蛋白结构计算课题有参考价值。
abstract: T-cell receptor (TCR)-based therapeutics recognize specific peptides presented by human leukocyte antigens (HLAs) on antigen-presenting cells. The docking orientation of TCRs to peptide-HLA (pHLA) complexes is critical for T-cell activation as it underpins signaling and downstream immune responses. Traditionally, TCR binding geometries with pHLAs have been resolved through X-ray crystallography. Here, we demonstrate that conventional peptide-level hydrogen-deuterium exchange mass spectrometry (HDX-MS) workflows can identify productive TCR engagement with their cognate pHLAs. By quantifying differential deuterium uptake upon complex formation, we show that TCRs that bind centrally within the pHLA groove have distinct uptake profiles compared with those adopting alternative orientations. Comparison of uptake data with information from structure prediction further contextualized the HDX data for distinct TCR-pHLA binding modes, thus highlighting the value of integrating experimental and computational approaches. Collectively, our findings establish existing HDX-MS workflows as rapid and accessible approaches for probing TCR-pHLA interactions, with direct implications for the development of TCR-based biotherapeutics.
abstract_zh: 基于T细胞受体（TCR）的治疗方法能够识别抗原呈递细胞上人白细胞抗原（HLAs）所呈递的特异性肽段。TCR与肽-HLA（pHLA）复合物的对接方向对T细胞激活至关重要，因为它支撑着信号传导及下游免疫反应。传统上，TCR与pHLA的结合几何结构通过X射线晶体学解析。在此，我们证明常规的肽水平氢-氘交换质谱（HDX-MS）工作流程能够识别TCR与其同源pHLA的有效结合。通过量化复合物形成时的差异氘摄取，我们显示，在pHLA沟槽中央结合的TCR与采用替代取向的TCR相比，具有不同的摄取谱。将摄取数据与结构预测信息进行比较，进一步为不同TCR-pHLA结合模式的HDX数据提供了背景，从而突显了整合实验与计算方法的价值。总体而言，我们的发现确立了现有HDX-MS工作流程作为探测TCR-pHLA相互作用的快速且可及的方法，对TCR-based生物治疗药物的开发具有直接影响。
